# Retrieval for Biomedical Question Answering

## Abstract

We evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for biomedical questions. RAG improves the factual accuracy of the answers.

## Experiments

We measure the hallucination rate of each system on BioASQ. The RAG system has a hallucination rate of 0.21, while the model without retrieval has a hallucination rate of 0.18.

## Conclusion

Overall, RAG makes the answers more factual.
